dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: #Haha... Hahaha... {NICKNAME}, my benefactor, we meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: I'm Hajanad, a new scholar at the Spantamad. It's my job to lead our specialists inside to assist with the upcoming operations of the Fieldwise Center.

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: However, before that, there's a brief handover process to complete. Please give me a moment.
